decision_source.statement: Admit formalize as a successor CLI package surface; freeze the current formalization epoch and authorize one independent review helper; adopt Product Capability domainspec.meta-type-semantic-enforcement with capability-local ontology domainspec.meta-type-semantic-enforcement-ontology@1; preserve baseline @10 as the immutable predecessor.

invariants: Baseline @10 remains immutable and is not regenerated or rewritten.
The formalize command is admitted only as the candidate.3 CLI package surface.
Formalization validation and independent review remain evidence, not proof of semantic preservation.
The Product Capability and capability-local business ontology own product meaning, not implementation or conformance.
Publication, release, deployment, production, and external effects remain unauthorized.
